t: You are looking at the Citigroup Centre, a complex of two buildings in Canary Wharf: 33 Canada Square and 25 Canada Square. Together they offer around 170,000 square metres of floor space and hold the European, Middle Eastern and African headquarters of Citigroup, along with most of its nine thousand UK staff. The two buildings were separated in 2023, before 25 Canada Square was renovated. The architect was César Pelli, the Argentine-American designer who also drew up much of the surrounding Canary Wharf skyline.
